Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.exception

Class DiwanError

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.exception.DiwanError
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class DiwanError extends Object implements Serializable
Describes a database failure in the same terms on every database: a stable code, and the name of the constraint and the columns involved when the database told.

The code has the form DWN-<group>-<number>, for example DWN-CST-0001 for a unique violation. Codes are public API: they are never renumbered or reused, and a failure with several kinds reports the code of the first kind in the order unique, foreign key, check, not null, concurrency, commit outcome unknown, connection lost, cancelled. A failure Diwan does not recognise has DWN-UNK-0000.

The key and columns are schema names, never values. Instances are immutable and safe to share between threads.

      @Internal public static DiwanError of(Set<DriverFailureKind> kinds, String key, List<String> columns)
      Builds the error for the kinds of a failure.
      Parameters:
      kinds - the kinds the driver recognised, may be null or empty
      key - the constraint or index name, or null when there is none
      columns - the column names, never null, may be empty; the list is copied
      Returns:
      the error, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if columns or one of its elements is null
      API Note:
